title: Navy and USS Lincoln’s Problems Are Tied to Attacks on U.S. Base Early in War
summary: Diego Garcia, a tiny island 2,200 miles from the Gulf of Oman, took over as the Navy’s logistics hub after Iran damaged a base in Bahrain.
